rationale: AC7 mandates coverage of two structurally separate bash -c call sites (fsm/runners.py shell branch, runner_spec.py::_run_cmd()); neither existing per-task object (ActionSpec, StateConfig) is visible to the other path, so a single-surface declaration cannot satisfy AC7. Both declarations converge on the shared project_child_env() enforcement chokepoint.
rule: Declare per-task credential scope on both ActionSpec and FSM StateConfig/loop-YAML independently (Option C)
alternatives_rejected: Option A (ActionSpec only) — leaves the FSM shell branch (fsm/runners.py:266) with no way to receive a declaration, zero ActionSpec references exist under fsm/. Option B (loop YAML only) — leaves runner_spec.py::_run_cmd() unreachable since it never calls resolve_host() or reads StateConfig.
